prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for most specific kinds of changes (adoption/new_screen, choose_path/copy, choose_path/layout, finish/redesign, sign_in/reorder), as each has only one test.
Wait-time information changes on home (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful and won, though evidence remains thin with only one test.
Predictions were mostly too high, but sign-in reordering was significantly underpredicted (+1.0% predicted vs +5.2% corrected).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: -1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +0.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -1.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +1.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +5.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.9%

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Redesign Pick Friend Carousel Showcase: Redesign the pet selection screen into a carousel layout showcasing animated pet previews and personality tags. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with median time 89s, showing significant friction and drop-off during pet selection.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Add Pet Controls Quickstart Screen: Insert a dedicated quickstart guide screen before completing onboarding that demonstrates key shortcuts to control, hide, and interact with the pet desktop overlay. (why: Support receives recurring tickets from users confused about how to hide, control, or talk to their pet after setup.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Add Pet Personality Trait Selection Flow: Introduce a trait selection screen immediately after choosing a pet so users can define starter mood and behavior. (why: High adoption drop-off (60.9%) indicates users need stronger emotional investment and personalization early in the journey.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Redesign Path Selection Spotlight Layout: Rebuild the path selection screen with a focused spotlight layout comparing adoptable vs custom pets clearly. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users on step 1 with high mean time (514s), signaling initial decision fatigue.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Clarify Account Sync Benefits on Sign In: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly state that signing in saves your pet permanently to your account. (why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
5: [home, hint] Add Desktop Workspace Spawn Hint: Add an explicit hint to the waiting screen explaining that the pet will appear directly over desktop windows once loading completes. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop or users assuming the app failed to open.)
6: [adoption, copy] Add Custom Creation Reassurance Copy: Add clear guidance text on the photo upload screen assuring users they can re-upload or tweak custom pets later. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failing or results looking unexpected.)
7: [finish, layout] Switch Home Intro to Card Layout: Reorganize the final welcome intro into a card layout with a prominent call to launch the pet onto the desktop. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with long median time (395s), showing users stall before completing onboarding.)
8: [choose_path, hint] Add Reassurance Hint to Choose Path: Display a hint explaining that users can adopt additional pets or create custom ones later. (why: Mean duration on path selection is 514s, showing severe hesitation on the initial choice.)
9: [finish, notification] Enable Notification Toggle on Home Intro: Enable desktop notification switch on the final screen so users get notified when their pet needs attention. (why: Users take 395s median on finish and report post-onboarding confusion regarding pet responsiveness.)
